title: lepidium hirtum subsp. calycotrichum
intro: Lepidium hirtum subsp. calycotrichum, commonly known as "Chilca" or "Papaloquelite", is a perennial plant species native to the Andean region. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to help with digestion, reduce inflammation, and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Lepidium hirtum subsp. calycotrichum include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
